front: When was Kirov murdered and why does it matter?
back: 1 December 1934; Stalin used it to begin the Terror.
He and seven other senior officers were tried in secret and shot in June 1937.

front: Why did Stalin launch the Terror?
back: Historians point to his wish to remove rivals, fear of war and a 'fifth column', scapegoats for failures and pressures from below.

front: What was the cult of personality?
back: Propaganda that presented Stalin as an all-wise leader ('Vozhd', Great Teacher), with statues, films and renamed places.

front: Why did Stalin sign the Nazi-Soviet Pact?
back: Collective security had failed (Munich), the USSR wanted time and territory, and it distrusted the West.
